title: A standing horse for the Western Hotel yard
items: A reconstructed standing horse joins the 1835 Western Hotel wagon yard at full or balanced detail.
Its selection card credits the licensed model and states that the animal’s identity, breed and owner are unknown.
Gentle reconstructed head and tail movements add life while its feet stay planted.
The horse remains unmounted, untied and unhitched; walking, riding and photographic refinement remain open.
